prediction_text: Main call: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election, defeating Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016. This is the call of the one panel astrologer singled out on the card — the same reader who picked Trump as Republican nominee back when 17 Republicans still contested it — and that reader stays with Trump for the general election. Timing fixed by the card: 8 Nov 2016.
basis:
Card carries no tradition field; the card singles out one panel astrologer's track record (Trump as nominee, called against a 17-candidate field), and the prediction is judged as that reader's mundane-astrology call.
systems_used: Western mundane astrology (individual forecaster's election call)
Direction duel: pro-Trump line (qualitative) — the card's only forecaster-specific evidence is this reader's demonstrated willingness and accuracy in backing Trump against consensus at the nomination stage; a reader whose signature call was Trump early does not switch to the favourite in the general; pro-Clinton line (qualitative) — polls and panel ambience favour Clinton, but those are magnitude/atmosphere items, not this reader's chart line. Verdict locked: Trump, following the individual reader rather than the panel treated in the companion card. Confidence mid-range: single-source framing, no chart data printed on the card.
